result.title: CoSphere-SLAM: Multi-Agent Panoramic Gaussian Splatting SLAM with Spherical Loop Closure
result.comment: 9 pages, 4 figures, 7 tables. Project website: https://cosphere-slam.github.io
result.summary: Dense collaborative mapping is essential for search and rescue, building inspection, and warehouse automation, where panoramic cameras capture the entire surroundings in a single frame. Unlike pinhole agents that share views only at similar headings, panoramic agents observe overlapping scenes at any 3D orientation, yet searching full rotations also produces mutually consistent false loop closures across distinct symmetric rooms. Moreover, continuous monocular scale drift splits rigidly merged maps at revisited surfaces, while depth noise at short baselines distorts loop translation directions. To address these challenges, we propose CoSphere-SLAM, the first multi-agent Gaussian splatting SLAM framework for panoramic cameras, whose spherical loop closure aligns spherical features over $\mathrm{SO}(3)$ via fast Fourier correlation across arbitrary orientations and rejects symmetric false closures through global $\mathrm{Sim}(3)$ consensus. Building on these closures, directional global optimization solves a per-keyframe $\mathrm{Sim}(3)$ pose graph with log-scale regularization to correct scale drift while separating optical-flow translation directions from depth-based magnitudes. Finally, omnidirectional Gaussian fusion transforms each Gaussian with its keyframe similarity and renders Gaussians at their maximum ray response to jointly refine poses and maps. Experiments on indoor and cross-session multi-agent panoramic benchmarks demonstrate that CoSphere-SLAM achieves state-of-the-art trajectory accuracy and rendering quality among single-agent and multi-agent methods. Project website: https://cosphere-slam.github.io.

AI.brief_summary: 提出面向全景相机的多智能体 Gaussian splatting SLAM 框架，用 SO(3) 上的球面特征相关做回环检测、以全局 Sim(3) 一致性剔除对称假回环，并通过带对数尺度正则的姿态图优化与全向 Gaussian 融合同时修正轨迹与地图。
AI.relevance_reason: 该文属三维建图与 SLAM 定位问题，其回环验证依赖几何一致性优化，不涉及视觉推理中的内部表示、推理状态生成或证据使用，与 LVR 主线缺少可核查的具体线索。
